envelope.description: Linkify and click handling in the review pane

body.title: Linkify and click handling in the review pane
body.summary: Inline the same exported linkify string once into the review shell inside DOCS_BODY_RENDERER_SOURCE, add the click handler posting through the pane's message channel, rewrite docs-review-panel.test.ts t4 for the new scrub, extend its stub DOM, and update the SHELL_BASELINE pins as the last step, once the shell source has stopped changing.
acceptanceChecks: the renderer source run against a stub DOM links a code reference, strips the href of an http link and posts open-code-ref and open-link on click
t4 asserts no href, a data-url and the unchanged non-http and image scrub
the shell-baseline tests hold with the new pins and the inlines-once test still passes

tests.name: the review pane renderer source, run against a stub DOM, links a code reference, strips the href of an http link, and posts open-code-ref and open-link on click
the chat page and the review pane both include the linkify and click wiring
